name: grimoire
description: A spellbook of opinionated Claude Code personas and utilities: warden (code review) and illusionist (decks and visual reports) subagents; sage (terse senior-engineer mode), go-runes (Go conventions), codex-rest and codex-grpc (API specs), glyph (architecture diagrams), and edict (decision records) skills; and seal (Conventional Commits) and recall (standup log) slash commands.
